name: siteflight
description: Run 40 overlooked website pre-launch checks across discoverability, content, conversion, trust, analytics, and operations.

interface.shortDescription: Forty overlooked checks before a website launches
interface.longDescription: SiteFlight audits 40 pre-launch checks that AI coding agents often leave unfinished, including technical SEO, Search Console, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, local-business details, content, conversion, trust, accessibility, analytics, legal pages, and launch behavior.
defaultPrompt: Audit this website before launch. Cover all 40 SiteFlight checks and show me what is still missing or unproven.
